look_here_first: Look at opposite leaves and rounded white flower heads on slender stalks; inspect bracts with a hand lens to distinguish from other Alternanthera.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Sprawling perennial, sometimes forming floating mats in wet habitats.

key_traits.label: Leaves attachment
key_traits.text: Simple opposite leaves at stem nodes.

key_traits.label: Flower reproductive
key_traits.text: White papery flowers in rounded stalked heads.

key_traits.label: Stem nodes
key_traits.text: Creeping stems can root at nodes.

key_traits.label: Fruit seed
key_traits.text: Tiny fruit; close-up not yet documented.
